column1: # XML tag samples Usage002_02/03/04: Java class factory recipes / Rust public rule composition.
# Hand oracle from the sample grammars, not from either implementation.
# input escapes: \r \n \t \\; empty first column = empty input.
# Recipe cells: N = success, consumed CP = matched CP = N, parsed source = first N CP;
# 02: no name comparison. paired: Usage002_03 and Usage002_04 (MatchedTokenParser over earlier names).
#   A close tag consumes the first candidate name that prefixes the input; later candidates are not retried.
#   Candidates are the TagIdentifier names (open and empty-element tags) on the current parse path in Java
#   transaction-stack order: the closing element's own name and its finished children, then the enclosing
#   open names from inner to outer. Each MatchedTokenParser instance keeps the list of its first evaluation
#   for the rest of the parse; the root instance is separate from the class-factory instance shared by all
#   nested levels, so a nested close reuses the list of the innermost close (xml-tags-candidate-cache.tsv).
#   Rows with prefix-related names were derived from that model and checked against the Java samples (#1016).
# scoped: owned capture + capture scope + replay of the innermost open name (not a sample class).
